Mike Pompeo Appointed as Chairman of Italy-Focused Uranium Miner Reveille Resources
U.K.-listed uranium exploration and development company Reveille Resources said it appointed former U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo as nonexecutive chairman.
Pompeo, who also headed up the Central Intelligence Agency, will assume the position immediately, the company said.
Reveille Resources' main business focus is on uranium projects in Italy.
